quote.author: Law Murray 📘
quote.text:
Keaton Wagler had a heads up steal and throw ahead to Darius Garland, who Wagler knew didn't make it back on defense after a crash landing

Only, Garland never made it up. Garland is still in the game even though Jasen Powell had to check him out on the baseline. Just a disturbing quarter

items.title: Gradey Dick on his motivation this year: “Just my love for basketball in general. I feel like an 82 game season, you can kind of lose that maybe. It’s easy to kind of get in the—go through the motions with different things. But I feel like you just got to snap out of it...”
